items: Questions frequently test that desert pavement forms specifically after deflation.
Yardangs are commonly asked about as landform indicators of prevailing wind direction.
Remember that Dreikanter refers strictly to a three-faced ventifact.
Loess is tested for its dual nature: high fertility paired with susceptibility to erosion.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Yardangs indicate prevailing wind direction in desert environments.
Dreikanter is defined as a ventifact possessing three faces.
Barchans are dynamic landforms that migrate along with the wind.
Loess is a fertile soil type that remains highly prone to erosion.
Desert pavement is formed as a direct result of deflation.
Playas are characteristically dry desert lake beds.
